title: Merchants never used
prompt: The partnerships team wants to know which signed-up merchants no customer has paid yet. Write `solve(merchants, transactions)` so it returns every merchant that appears in no transaction.
rules: A merchant counts as used if any transaction has its `merchant_id`, whatever the transaction's status.
Transactions without a merchant, such as deposits, don't make any merchant used.
Return every column of `merchants`, unchanged, one row per unused merchant.
hints: You want the merchants with no match in `transactions`.
One join type keeps exactly the left rows that have no match.
